title: The elevators! I had a breakthrough last night.
content: TL;DR I discovered the elevators are responsive to voice and don’t go insane if you tell it to just do its job. Despite my username, I had my first real proper lucid dream last night. I was about to get in the elevator when I just _knew_ they’d do what they usually do and go haywire. I had this overwhelming feeling of “this elevator is going to go crazy and scare me like it usually does in my dreams”. It was then I became lucid and _aware_ , and I was so excited. So I tested it by flying… sure enough, I was flying. I flew over my whole dream world, in and out of apartment building windows that I’d seen/dreamt about many times, and felt so free! To fly, I have to engage my core and almost fall onto the ground - when I do this, suddenly I can feel what I can only describe as “magnetism”, as if I am an opposing force and gravity is working against me so I can glide around. Anyway, I then tested the elevator by seeing if it would still go crazy when I got in. I remember pressing “level 20” and sure enough it randomly starting switching floors, going sideways, dropping quickly to the ground, giving me that horrible dreadful feeling. Then I said “elevator. Stop. Just floor 20”. And the elevator behaved normally, taking me to level 20. I got out, and repeated the test - press a button, say nothing, the elevator goes insane. Use my voice to control it, and it behaves. It feels like a breakthrough for me.
